caseNameFull: KNIGHT v. BOARD OF REGENTS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK
attorneys: Alan H. Levine and Jeremiah S. Gutman for appellants., Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Samuel A. Hirshowitz, First Assistant Attorney General, and Charles A. La Torella, Jr., and Maria L. Marcus, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and.the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Stewart is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
